minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  July 22, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:30 a.m.:

  Members Present: Debbie Crenshaw, City Treasurer
  Kenneth Campos, City Attorney
  Maria Heaney, Revenue Manager

  Staff Present:  Debra Carter, City Attorney’s Office

1. The minutes of July 08, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Closed Session- Confidential
  Rocio Maldonado vs City of Inglewood- A motion was moved and second to
  recommend settlement payment up to $3,917.54.

3. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:37 a.m.

Adjournment
